note: Per measurement area (MDI). gnn: DimeNet++ surrogate applied to 1,000 random fcc(111) slabs at the EDX composition; hads_histogram counts the 9,000 dilute (1/9 ML) hydrogen adsorption energies (eV, relative to 1/2 E(H2), RPBE, no ZPE or entropy) in bins of width bin_width_eV, bin i covering [bin_start_eV + (first_bin + i)*w, +w); wf: mean and spread of the 1,000 slab work functions (eV). linear_combination: scalar baseline estimates of the adsorption energy (meV) and work function (eV), the composition-weighted sum of per-element coefficients fitted to the DFT set.
